description: [WRITE] Update an item's attributes using an update expression. Supports SET, REMOVE, ADD, DELETE actions and conditional updates. REMOVE/ADD/DELETE on key attributes are rejected. Arithmetic uses arbitrary-precision decimal.

condition_expression.description: Condition expression that must be satisfied for the update to succeed

expression_attribute_names.description: Substitution tokens for expression attribute names

expression_attribute_values.description: Substitution tokens for expression attribute values, in DynamoDB JSON format

key.description: Primary key of the item to update, in DynamoDB JSON format. Example: {"pk": {"S": "user#1"}, "sk": {"S": "profile"}}

return_consumed_capacity.description: What consumed capacity to return: TOTAL for the operation's total, INDEXES for the total broken down by table and index, or NONE (the default) for none. Figures follow DynamoDB's charging rules and match what the DynamoDB API returns for the same request.

return_values.description: What to return: NONE, ALL_OLD, UPDATED_OLD, ALL_NEW, or UPDATED_NEW

return_values_on_condition_check_failure.description: What to return on ConditionalCheckFailedException: ALL_OLD or NONE

update_expression.description: Update expression, e.g. "SET #n = :val, age = age + :inc REMOVE obsolete"

name: update_item
